editorial:
Imagine finding out you aren't even from this planet and that you're actually the first superhero on Earth. That is exactly what happens in this wild ride. You get to follow a guy who is just starting to wrap his head around his alien roots while teaming up with a ragtag group of local vigilantes. The vibe is a mix of big superhero energy and street-level grit. It feels like a comic book come to life, where a few brave underdogs take on a massive, scary secret society that wants to control the entire world. You will feel the tension as they plan their move against the bad guys.

What really works here are the action scenes and the chemistry between the team members. The pacing stays quick, so you never feel bored, though some of the special effects look a bit low-budget in a few spots. If you love stories about hidden identities and fighting the system, you will dig this. For the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see the action clearly, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, the hero uses his full alien powers to destroy the secret society's main weapon. He leads the vigilantes in a massive fight that breaks the villains' hold over the city. The twist is that the secret society had a traitor in their own ranks who helped the heroes win. Everything wraps up with the world finally knowing about aliens, and the group decides to stay together to protect people from future threats.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves comic book stories and underdog teams.
